Definition: to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive
BiblicalUsage: tsârar is the word for to bind, press, distress. It appears 52 times in Scripture, including Deuteronomy 28:52 and 1 Samuel 25:29.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave us tsârar because the idea it carries belongs in His Word.
